serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
You: Do you want to go to Annalie?
#bot.Expression.Clear
Bot: Yeah! Since the riots ended I never went to visit her.
You: I went there alone. 
You: During riots her shop got hit pretty hard, but she’s a hardworking girl so her shop is almost back to normal.
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: If only I was there… {{wi}}I would eliminate any threats to her shop.
I’m kinda glad you weren’t there for that reason…
You: Alright then. Let’s go see her.
